_comment: Consumed by scripts/frontend_api_coverage_gate.py (STAGE 3.92b). Each entry below was individually verified this session -- not name-guessed -- by confirming zero <form> and zero fetch( occurrences in the file (grep -c), ruling out any client-side call this gate's regex could plausibly miss (see cves.html/ransomware.html false-negative fix in the same commit). A page is added here only when it is genuinely static (marketing, legal, informational, or a one-off internal report artifact) with no live data or form-submission surface at all. This is a starting batch, not a claim of completeness -- most of the platform's other static pages remain deliberately unclassified (visible in the coverage report, not silently assumed safe) until verified the same way.
verified_method: grep -c '<form' <file> && grep -c 'fetch(' <file>, both == 0, plus a name/purpose check
second_batch_note: Second batch (sentinel-apex-transformation session): 69 pages left unclassified by the first batch were read in full and triaged; the 22 below passed the identical zero-<form>/zero-fetch( mechanical re-check (two initial candidates, api-docs.html and intelligence-archive.html, were EXCLUDED after re-verification: api-docs.html has real interactive try-it fetch() calls, and intelligence-archive.html genuinely fetches live JSON from /data/intelligence_repository/*.json -- a real data source outside the /api/ gateway this gate's regex doesn't recognize, not a placeholder. Both are tracked as CUSTOMER_UI in data/quality/frontend_capability_registry.json instead of here). The remaining unclassified pages from that pass are CUSTOMER_UI orphans (real defects, tracked in the capability registry, not silenced here), ADMIN/INTERNAL pages (also tracked, not static-marketing), or CUSTOMER_UI form-only pages (have a <form> by definition, so cannot pass this file's own zero-<form> bar -- tracked in the registry instead of stretched into this list).
